result: Fixed 6 critical issues in NL Workflow frontend module
fixes_applied: 1. Token Storage Key Inconsistency: Fixed streamWorkflow and streamMessage methods to use credentials: 'include' instead of manual Authorization header with localStorage token. This ensures cookies are sent for CSRF and DRF TokenAuth.
2. Removed Duplicate getSession Method: Verified only one getSession definition exists in nl-workflow.js (line 31).
3. Removed Legacy streamGenerate Method: Deleted the deprecated EventSource-based streamGenerate method from nl-workflow.js.

4. Fixed Field Name Mapping in Creator.vue: Changed all occurrences of sessionId to session_id, workflowId to workflow_id, createdAt to created_at, messageCount to node_count, and workflowName to workflow_name to match the backend snake_case response format.
5. Fixed sendMessage flow control bug: Moved the _isCreatingSession check to the beginning of the function (before setting isLoading) to properly guard against duplicate session creation submissions.
6. Fixed loadHistory response parsing: Changed response.results to response.data to match the backend's NLSessionViewSet.list() return format.
summary: Fixed all 6 critical issues in the NL Workflow frontend module. Key changes: (1) Replaced manual Authorization header with credentials: 'include' in both streamWorkflow and streamMessage for proper cookie-based auth; (2) Removed legacy streamGenerate method; (3) Fixed all field name mappings from camelCase to snake_case to match Django backend (_build_session_list_item response format): session.sessionId→session.session_id, session.workflowId→session.workflow_id, session.createdAt→session.created_at, session.messageCount→session.node_count, session.workflowName→session.workflow_name; (4) Fixed sendMessage flow control by moving the duplicate submission guard to the start of the function; (5) Fixed loadHistory to use response.data instead of response.results.
